brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir is preparing to unveil a $20 billion proposal to relocate Gaza's population over a seven-year period, Middle East Eye reported. The far-right official intends to present the plan as a prerequisite for his participation in future Israeli coalition negotiations, positioning it as a core demand in any power-sharing arrangement.

The proposal marks Ben Gvir's latest effort to shape Israeli policy toward Gaza following years of conflict. His decision to tie the plan to coalition talks signals his intent to leverage his political position to advance the initiative at the highest levels of government.

title: Ben Gvir plans $20bn Gaza resettlement scheme over seven years
